query: For the paper "Sentiment Analysis of Czech Texts: An Algorithmic Survey" (arXiv: 1901.02780), answer this question: Did the authors collect new data for evaluation?

drafts: No, the authors did not collect new data for evaluation. They used two existing datasets — Facebook posts and Mall product reviews — for their experiments with various supervised learning algorithms [3].

requirements.answer_quote: No, the authors did not collect new data for evaluation. They used two existing datasets — Facebook posts and Mall product reviews — for their experiments with various supervised learning algorithms [3].
requirements.reason: 答案明确指出作者没有收集新数据，而是使用两个已有数据集（Facebook帖子与Mall商品评论），与原文结论段直接一致。

citations.quote: In this paper, we tried various supervised learning algorithms for sentiment analysis of Czech texts us- ing two existing datasets of Facebook posts and Mall product reviews.

cited_sources.text: 6 CONCLUSIONS In this paper, we tried various supervised learning algorithms for sentiment analysis of Czech texts us- ing two existing datasets of Facebook posts and Mall product reviews. We grid-searched various param- eters of Tf-Idf vectorizer and each of the machine learning algorithms. According to our observations, best sentiment predictions are achieved when bigrams are added, Czech stop words are not removed and l2 normalization is applied in vectorization.
